events.verdict: Ball (CHA) moves into Butler's (MIA) space and delivers contact after his gather, which alters his driving shot attempt.
Rozier (MIA) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact as Mann (CHA) attempts to defend around the pick.
Bridges (CHA) and Rozier (MIA) engage and disengage away from the ball.

Bridges (CHA) reaches in for the ball and initiates contact with Butler (MIA) that affects his SQBR during his dribble into the frontcourt. The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Mann (CHA) establishes himself in Rozier's (MIA) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Bridges (CHA) legally contests Rozier's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Martin (CHA) makes direct contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it from Rozier's (MIA) grasp.
After Martin (CHA) dislodges the ball, Rozier (MIA) legally goes into the backcourt in his attempt to recover the loose ball.
Rozier (MIA) and Bridges (CHA) both bring their hands to the ball and neither player is able to gain sole control over it. A held ball is correctly called on this play.
Ball (CHA) wraps his arm around Butler's (MIA) shoulder and neck region, delivering contact that dislodges Butler as both players pursue the tipped ball.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Ball's (CHA) driving dunk attempt at the basket.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Ball (CHA) makes last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Miami.
